title: coleus unguentarius
intro: Coleus unguentarius, commonly known as Coleus aromaticus, is a species of flowering plant in the family Lamiaceae. It is traditionally used in Ayurvedic medicine, valued for its potential health benefits, which include its ability to aid in digestion, reduce inflammation, and lower blood pressure. The therapeutic actions of Coleus unguentarius are attributed to its bioactive constituents, which include iridoids, flavonoids, and glycosides, that exhibit antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and anti-diabetic properties. Additionally, the plant is rich in essential oils, which contribute to its aromatic and medicinal properties.
